name: Centro Legal de la Raza
description: Free bilingual legal services in immigration, housing, and workers' rights for East Bay communities
fullDescription: Centro Legal de la Raza provides free bilingual legal services to low-income, immigrant, and communities of color, specializing in immigration, housing, and workers' rights.
whatTheyOffer:
- Immigration legal services, including help for detained people in removal proceedings, asylum seekers, and crime victims
- Tenant rights and eviction defense for Alameda and Contra Costa County tenants
- Workers' rights help for low-wage immigrant workers (wage theft, unsafe conditions, retaliation)
- Alameda County Housing Secure legal help and emergency financial assistance for tenants and homeowners
- Free Know Your Rights clinics for immigrants, tenants, and workers
- Bilingual services (English/Spanish)
howToGetIt:
1. Call 510-437-1554 to request a consultation or register for a clinic
2. Remote workers' rights drop-in clinics are held monthly (third Wednesday 9 AM–12 PM; 2nd, 4th, and 5th Thursdays 6–9 PM); appointments recommended
3. Tenants can join monthly tenants' rights clinics and workshops
4. To report ICE activity or get rapid response help in Alameda County, call ACILEP at 510-241-4011
5. Complete intake and eligibility screening
